summary: The US government issued an export control directive requiring Anthropic to suspend all foreign-national access to its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models over an alleged jailbreak-related national security concern, which Anthropic is complying with while disputing the underlying rationale.

mechanisms.reason: A government export control directive is being used to restrict foreign-national access to specific frontier AI models, a new application of export authority to model deployment rather than hardware.
mechanisms.quote: The US government, citing national security authorities, has issued an export control directive to suspend all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by any foreign national, whether inside or outside the United States

notable_reason: A government has for the first time invoked export control authority to force a frontier lab to pull a deployed commercial model over an alleged jailbreak, a precedent-setting regulatory intervention in AI deployment.
